card.name: Inside antiviral combination drug names
card.fires_on: Marks the end of or a link after an antiviral drug name (emtricitabine, elvitegravir, glecaprevir) in labels for HIV or hepatitis combination products. It also appears on joining words between co-formulated components.

modes.label: Drug name ending
modes.description: The last piece of an antiviral drug name, or a slash inside a combination name.
modes.example: components of emtricitab<<ine>> and tenofovir disoprox

modes.label: Link between components
modes.description: An 'and', 'or', comma or 'of' right after one antiviral component, before the next one.

card.plain: It fires on antiviral drug names and the small words that join them in combination-product lists, such as for HIV or hepatitis.
